{#- Header menu for the community pages. The items come from _data/community.yaml by way of _ext/community.py, which marks the item that covers the current page. navbar() is the bar itself; on small screens its items move into offcanvas(), a menu that slides in from the side. search_form() submits to the Sphinx search page: on wide screens it opens over the menu items when you press the search button or "/", and on small screens it sits at the top of the slide-in menu. Links are site-absolute ("/conf/", and "/" for the logo) rather than built with pathto(), so they also work on the 404 page, which can be served at any URL. -#} {%- macro search_form(input_id, autofocus=False) -%}
